title: No fancy average
summary: Attention can be “who tipped together,” without a fancy normalization.

cards.text:
Ordinary attention builds a dense table of scores
and then does a fancy average.

Spikformer lets the queries, keys, and values be tips,
and drops that average.

question.prompt: What did they remove from attention?
question.why: The softmax is the clearest non-tip in ordinary attention.
question.simpler: The reported ImageNet number, 74.81%, belongs with 4 moments and about 66 million parameters.

question.prompt: Four moments is a long rate window.
question.why: Four is too short to be a settled copy of a brightness.
question.simpler: This is a directly taught spiking attention, not the slow copy.

recall.question: Are Spikformer’s queries ordinary real numbers?

deeper.note: Zhou and colleagues, ICLR 2023. After you drop the average, still ask whether the lookup table is a dense block. The next level pushes on that.

paper.title: Spikformer: When Spiking Neural Network Meets Transformer
paper.section: Figure 1 and spiking self-attention. The ImageNet number is a result, with 4 timesteps.

terms.definition: An attention block whose queries, keys, and values are spikes and which drops softmax.
